notes:
- Updates can't get stuck anymore: Snap Mixer saves each new version separately and just opens the newest one.
- After installing, Snap Mixer restarts right away in the new version.
- If a new version ever fails to open, Snap Mixer goes back to the one that works on its own.
- Settings has a small "Go back to the previous version" link, in case an update has a problem.
- "What's new" now opens here, inside Snap Mixer, instead of the GitHub page.
- Load and Unload buttons under each filament, on the computer (Device tab) and in the phone app.
